issues.on_page: Insurance proceeds 186,363; Sale of equipment 3,505; Back-dated tax settlements 988,055 (under Other Financing Sources)
issues.issue: The amounts and sum are correct and follow the statement's Other Financing Sources section. But back-dated tax settlements (code 6400) are really tax receipts, and the rules otherwise put insurance proceeds under reimbursements/refunds. Treating them as financing rather than receipts is a judgment call.

detail[0], detail[43] and detail[49] keep 'County Treasurer - taxes' unsplit. p4 prints property / motor vehicle / public power district taxes for each fund column, but those lines also include the 'other state receipts' line (General 46,451,351 + 75,590 = 46,526,941; Bond 10,869,204 + 901,141 = 11,770,345; Special Building 2,981,058 + 1,399,152 = 4,380,210), so a clean split isn't printed. Keeping them unlabeled is defensible. Note that p4's tax lines therefore hold some state receipts (receipts[0..2]).

issues.on_page: Employee Benefits Fund - Special Pay Deferral, function code 2900, 47,522
issues.issue: An employee special pay deferral isn't student-activity spending. p4 only lumps it into 'Activities supplies and materials'. support services (other support, code 2900) seems a better fit.

The Salaries line is split 40,194 / 3,165 using the p4 Other Governmental Funds function column. That's a derived breakdown, not one printed for this line, and it is marked computed/split_from. The 90,000 budget is dropped from both parts (detail[62], detail[63]). Consider keeping one line of 43,359 with budget 90,000.
Food bought for resale could be 'purchased power/cost of sales'. Judgment call.
